LightningComponentBundle.description: Navigate to a Notion page for a Salesforce record. Configure title, navigation style, alignment, and sync behavior in the page editor.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: The ID of the Salesforce record

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The API name of the Salesforce object

property.name: autoRedirect
property.label: Auto Redirect
property.description: Automatically redirect to Notion if the page exists

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title shown in the component header

property.name: showTitle
property.label: Show Title
property.description: Show the card header with title and icon

property.name: navigationStyle
property.label: Navigation Style
property.description: Render the navigation action as a button or text link

property.name: actionLabel
property.label: Action Label
property.description: Label shown on the navigate action

property.name: showActionLabel
property.label: Show Action Label
property.description: Show the action label text. When off, only the icon is shown.

property.name: actionAlignment
property.label: Action Alignment
property.description: Horizontal alignment of the navigation action

property.name: syncBeforeNavigate
property.label: Sync Before Navigate
property.description: Sync the record to Notion before navigating. When 'Show Sync Option' is on, this sets the checkbox's initial state.

property.name: showSyncOption
property.label: Show Sync Option
property.description: Show a checkbox letting the user opt into syncing before navigating, on each click.
